
# CMaNGOS Dynamic XP - Addon
I’ve created an addon for CMaNGOS with Dynamic XP that allows players to control their experience gain rate by right-clicking their XP bar. This addon is perfect for players who want to customize their leveling experience without the need for command knowledge, whether they prefer a faster pace or the classic Blizzlike progression.
  
# How to install
*Players can skip step one.*
1) Look at this [commit]([https://github.com/azerothcore/mod-individual-xp](https://github.com/brian8544/CMaNGOS/commit/19a6e6f540cb304d1f33b70680f523c3798fcd08))
2) Apply this addon into your World of Warcraft folder.
